decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-56 MODIFY capturing the informational pages, required background and header logo, and optional footer. Detailed footer content remains owned by the footer Requirement.
The candidate's message-56 INTRODUCE already captures all four legal-document links. No additional or incomplete candidate update remains.

The existing message-56 MODIFY already establishes the wizard's informational purpose, required background and header logo, optional footer, and removal of superseded styling details. Optional footer inclusion does not require duplicating footer content.
The existing message-56 MODIFY fully captures the sign-in page's visual requirements and optional footer. The footer's detailed contents remain independently represented by the footer Requirement.
Using the landing-page background as a basis for authentication pages does not change the landing page's own visual system, and the footer treatment is a separate Requirement.
References to company information, email, and phone occur in unrelated footer and informational-page content and do not change the How It Works section.
The source concerns the public website footer and informational website pages, not the independently scoped SaaS console shell or its footer.
The source specifies footer content and simple informational-page elements but makes no change to responsive breakpoints or cross-page responsive rules.
The source does not modify the landing page's responsive behavior or identify any new viewport-specific layout rule.
A proposed solid footer background using an existing brand color does not alter the requested token sheet, font files, content-width specification, or unresolved handoff scope.
The footer expansion and creation of informational pages do not change whether previously supplied follow-on copy belongs on the landing page.
Mentioning a Sign In informational page does not change the landing page's separate sign-up button requirement.
